visualCharacteristics.structure: 5 horizontal image panels + title + translucent text box + CTA + expandable detail overlay with link lists

contentPattern.cell1: Teaser: background image, category title (h2) or title image, optional top CTA link ('Cotiza tu seguro'), subtitle (h3), lead paragraph, primary CTA link
contentPattern.cell2: Detail (optional, empty for panel 5): h2 intro + paragraph, optional h3 group headings, bulleted list of product links (link text followed by tooltip description in the same list item), optional slider images, footer CTA link
